title: LifegamesCopyErrors
description: Rich authoring schema for the errors slice of @lifegames/copy. Cross-repo user-facing error display text: the backend is the canonical source of these strings and the iOS client decodes + presents them rather than hardcoding its own. Two groups: `validation` (backend Zod request-validation messages returned to the client) and `client` (iOS networking connection-test result strings). Each leaf is a CopyString carrying authoring context in _meta, with usage citing BOTH the backend and iOS render sites. The copy build derives a FLAT schema from this one (stripping _meta) for all consumer codegen (TS/Zod/Swift). Strings are authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax; the client.serverReturned leaf is an interpolated template carrying its ICU placeholder ({code}). Stored in natural case. Every object group has a UNIQUE title (Err*) so quicktype-derived Swift struct names never collide across namespaces. The $defs block is byte-identical to schema/identity.schema.json, schema/widgets.schema.json, schema/a11y.schema.json, schema/app.schema.json, and schema/permissions.schema.json; the $defs are inlined per schema file (no cross-file $ref), which the flat-schema derivation requires.

validation.title: ErrValidation
validation.description: Backend request-validation error messages (Zod schema messages returned to the client on 400).

client.title: ErrClient
client.description: iOS client networking connection-test result strings (connection-success message and HTTP-error template).

CopyMeta.description: Authoring context attached to every copy leaf (D6). Drives auditing, reconciliation, and CI-lintable constraints.

description.description: What this string is and why it exists.

usage.description: Every render site / placement where this string appears (file:line or surface name). Makes duplication and placement visible for reconciliation (D11).

register.description: Voice register (see packages/copy/VOICE.md): atom | label | factual | expressive | machine | brand | consent.

audience.description: Primary audience: human | machine | dual. Drives the human↔AI arbitration rule (machine/dual surfaces stay literal/parseable).

lastReviewed.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the wording was last deliberately reviewed.

maxChars.description: Maximum rendered length. CI fails if value exceeds this.

rationale.description: Optional: why this wording/variant exists distinctly (intent, history).

CopyString.description: A single customer-facing string (ICU MF1 syntax) plus its authoring context.

value.description: The string, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.

CopyStringList.description: An ordered list of customer-facing strings (each ICU MF1) plus shared authoring context.

value.description: The strings, each authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.
